articles.summary: NEW ALBANY, Ohio, Nov. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - CVG (NASDAQ: CVGI) (“CVG” or the “Company”), a diversified industrial products and services company, today announced that, in connection with the previously announced appointment of David Ruppel as President and Chief Executive Officer effective November 9, 2026, CVG granted Mr. Ruppel equity awards as a material inducement to his acceptance of employment with CVG in accordance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4). The awards were approved by CVG’s independent directors on October 30, 2026 and were granted outside of CVG’s Second Amended and Restated 2020 Equity Incentive Plan (the “Plan”), but are subject to terms and conditions consistent with those of awards granted under the Plan. On November 9, 2026, CVG granted Mr. Ruppel the following awards: Make-whole awards in respect of unvested equity awards that Mr. Ruppel forfeited upon leaving his prior employer, Littelfuse, Inc., consisting of (i) 611,481 restricted shares of CVG common
articles.title: CVG Announces Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
